notes.title: A New Update is Finally Here!
notes.content:
This update took far longer than we anticipated, so let me open by saying that we're sorry for making you wait. Now, let's get into the juicy stuff. In this new update you'll find:

- New blocks. In the free build mode you'll find a new molecule builder kit, toy bricks, chess pieces, and character blocks. 
- We've redesigned the reflection tool so that it's more mathematically accurate.
-We've added a mirror tool in free build mode
-We added, wonder of wonders, TRANSPARENCY to the Minecraft blocks, and it looks really great
-We've added a reference image  viewer so you can load images from your machine to your 3dSunshine world
- We condensed the block libraries. Now you can swap between different block types
-We've updated to an arena style menu so you don't have to swap between several different pages

Note: You will no longer be able bring structures built in Minecraft mode to freebuild mode because they are aren't compatible with the new mirror mode.

notes.title: Build Update 0.3.4: Many Requested Features.
notes.content:
Hey y'all, for this build we decided to focus on some small, but often requested little features. You'll find:

- The inventory now persists across sessions. Store things in your inventory, quit, and restart.... they will still be there!

- You can rotate blocks/groups while holding them by moving your thumb on the trackpad. Just pick up a block/group as before and try swiping the trackpad. You should see the block/group spin around and around.
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7bukgJ6HWEu1fXlC/giphy.gif]

- You can clear things from the inventory using the grip button. The grip button will not only remove the block/group from the inventory, it will also empty out that inventory slot. (the trigger button continues to remove the block/group *without* emptying its slot).

- Freebuild mode now remembers your bench size. When you save a freebuild scene, and then reload it, your bench setup should be remembered. (is this a feature? or have we merely fixed a bug? you decide ;).

notes.title: 0.3.2 3dSunshine Update: .obj Export + Other Things
notes.content:
Hey y'all we've just released another build. It's small, but sweet. Here is what you can expect:

- .obj export (press the menu button and look to your left -- the interface is hard to miss). Your .obj will be exported to documents/3dSunshine. Check out some of the models we've uploaded to sketchfab from [url=https://skfb.ly/6nXyq]Space Engineers [/url] and [url=https://skfb.ly/6nXxB]Minecraft.[/url]
-You can clear your inventory now! No more junk.
-StilesMode (this is actually from last build) to turn this on go to settings. This will let you place blocks in the air without snapping them to something else. This can take time to load, so be patient. 
-Some other small stuff, we made it easier to skip tutorials, fixed some of our MC textures (we plan on doing more of this), and added some helpful tips when you hover over more complicated tools.

notes.title: 3dSunshine 0.3.1 is Full of New Features!
notes.content:
We just pushed 0.3.1, and it's full of exciting stuff. 

You'll notice some small stuff:
-Space Engineers blocks snap more readily
- We fixed the bug that required you to have mouse focus on 3dSunshine  for the program to function properly
- If you're an Oculus user you'll notice nicer Touch controller models

And some bigger stuff:
-You can now toggle between block and group mode on the controller itself
- We added block type filters and search for Space Engineers blocks 


And a really big thing
- Dye for Space Engineers. Here are some of the ways you can use dye:

Ink Pearls
-You can drag an ink through an SE block, and it will change colors
-You can also drag SE blocks through ink, and they will color
-You can snap inks together to make structures (which you can drag through things — like making a stamp or a sword you can paint with)

Color Picker
-You can use the Color Picker to generate new ink. Drag the slider to change the color of the ink at the top. Then you can grab that ink and use it to color things.
-You can drag ink onto the pin on top of the Color Picker to set the color of the picker
-You can drag a group of blocks (and/or inks) onto the Color Picker to set its color to the average of those colors

Coloring the SE Library
-You can drag a block or ink onto the SE Color Picker to set the color picker to the color of that block or ink
-If you drag a group of blocks and/or inks onto the library, all blocks colors are set to the average color of the group

Dye Tool
-Put an ink on the pin on the back of your controller to set the color for the Dye Tool
-With a color set, click and drag on SE blocks to change their color
-You can also bring your tips together, cross them, and make a volume to color many blocks at once
-If you drag a group (of blocks and/or inks) onto the Dye Tool, then each block you color will randomly get one of the colors of that group

We're going to release a build video tomorrow, as well as a more in depth tutorial on dye. So stay tuned for those.

notes.title: v. 0.3.0 Update: Space Engineers Support is Here!
notes.content:
We've been talking about adding supporting a second game for a long time, and the day has finally arrived. This a huge deal for our team, and we're so excited to share our compatibility with the extremely awesome [url="http://store.steampowered.com/app/244850/"]Space Engineers[/url] with you all. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FP-8uanyDeM

The Space Engineers community has been incredibly helpful and supportive as we finished our first wave of support. Check out w4asted space's video below (note: he was using an early build and we've fixed all of his issues). https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I4A4mC-8k3w

notes.title: v. 0.2.4 Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We're still on target to release Space Engineers support sometime in January. In the mean time we've just pushed an update. You'll find that:

-We've fixed the major saving issue that was plaguing everyone. 

- In tutorial #4 we've added a step that will show you how to use the glue tool to define your own groups.

-We added a button to the block library which will let you sort blocks by type (this is very basic at the moment, we plan to improve it soon).
